target.statement: Tuned Random Forest test-set accuracy of 0.8918 (and ROC AUC 0.9586) for predicting 5-star NCAP overall rating
target.table_ref: Table 3, Random Forest row, Accuracy column

compute.basis: Small tabular dataset (~5k rows, 24 features) with sklearn RandomForest + RandomizedSearchCV (20 iters x 5 folds) fits in minutes on 8 CPU cores; main cost is downloading/cleaning the NHTSA CSV and re-deriving the exact preprocessing, which is described but not released as code.

blockers: No code released; preprocessing (ADAS category mapping, column selection, missing-value handling) must be re-implemented from prose
Exact Safercar_data.csv snapshot/version not pinned, so row count and results may drift
Exact hyperparameter search space and random seeds not reported, so exact 0.8918 may not be bit-reproducible
title: Predicting NCAP Safety Ratings: An Analysis of Vehicle Characteristics and ADAS Features Using Machine Learning
